verdict.rationale: The CRA publishes a system-to-system EFILE channel for certified software, so asking whether a sandbox or test environment exists is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents a sandbox, test environment, or non-production endpoint. The EFILE software certification process verifies compatibility but is not shown to be an isolated test environment a user can work against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
